### Defining funcions
```{r Functions, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
generate_volcano_plot <- function(toptable, title) {
  
  # #check for entrezid 
  # if(!"Entrez_ID" %in% colnames(toptable)) stop("Entrez_ID col not present")
  # 
  #make significance labels
  
  toptable <- toptable %>% 
    mutate(Significance = case_when(
      logFC > 0 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Upregulated",
      logFC < 0 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE  ~ "Not Significant"
    ))
  
  #factor significance
  toptable$Significance <- factor(
    toptable$Significance, 
    levels = c("Upregulated", 
               "Not Significant", 
               "Downregulated")
  )
  
  #count genes in each category
  upgenes <- sum(toptable$Significance == "Upregulated")
  nsgenes <- sum(toptable$Significance == "Not Significant")
  downgenes <- sum(toptable$Significance == "Downregulated")
  
  
  #labels for legend
  legend_lab <- c(
    paste0("Upregulated: ", upgenes),
    paste0("Not Significant: ", nsgenes),
    paste0("Downregulated: ", downgenes)
  )
  
  #colors 
  color_map <- c("Upregulated" = "blue",
                 "Not Significant" = "grey30",
                 "Downregulated" = "red")
  
  #generate volcano plots
  p <- ggplot(toptable, aes(x = logFC, 
                            y = -log10(P.Value),
                            color = Significance)) +
    geom_point_rast(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map, 
                       labels = legend_lab,
                       breaks = c("Upregulated",
                                  "Not Significant", 
                                  "Downregulated"))  +
    ylim(0,20) +
    xlim(-20,20) +
    labs(title = title, 
         x = expression("log"[2]*"FC"),
         y = expression("-log"[10]*"p-value")) +
    # theme_custom() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  return(p)
}


#FC_Plot_Function_sig_Species

plot_cluster_fc_sig_species <- function(gene_vector, cluster_name, top_table) {

  df <- top_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene %in% gene_vector) %>%
    mutate(Comparisons = factor(Comparisons, levels = c(
      "HvC_Day0","HvC_Day2","HvC_Day4","HvC_Day5","HvC_Day15","HvC_Day30"
    )))

  cat(cluster_name, ":", nrow(df), "rows,",
      length(unique(df$Gene)), "unique genes\n")

  # ✅ Skip if no data
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    message(cluster_name, ": no data — skipping")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ✅ Skip if only one comparison present
  if (length(unique(df$Comparisons)) < 2) {
    message(cluster_name, ": only one comparison — skipping stats")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Stats
  kw <- kruskal.test(logFC ~ Comparisons, data = df)

  pw_kw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
    df$logFC,
    df$Comparisons,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  )

  print(pw_kw)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Comparisons, y = logFC)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Comparisons)) +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab(" ") +
    ylab("logFC") +
    ggtitle(
      paste0(
        cluster_name,
        " Species DEG FC Comparisons\nKruskal–Wallis p = ",
        signif(kw$p.value, 3)
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-4, 4)) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = rel(1.3), hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 15)
    )

  return(p)
}

    message(cluster_name, ": no data — skipping")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ✅ Skip if only one comparison present
  if (length(unique(df$Comparisons)) < 2) {
    message(cluster_name, ": only one comparison — skipping stats")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Stats
  kw <- kruskal.test(logFC ~ Comparisons, data = df)

  pw_kw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
    df$absfc,
    df$Comparisons,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  )

  print(pw_kw)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Comparisons, y = absfc)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Comparisons)) +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab(" ") +
    ylab("logFC") +
    ggtitle(
      paste0(
        cluster_name,
        " Trajectory DEGs FC Comparisons\nKruskal–Wallis p = ",
        signif(kw$p.value, 3)
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4)) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = rel(1.3), hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 15)
    )

  return(p)
}

#get_directional_genes

get_fc_directions <- function(traj_label, coef_name, comparison_label,
                              top_table_all, fit_obj, p_cutoff = 0.05, gene_set = NULL) {

  # ---------------------------
  # trajectory FC data
  # ---------------------------
  df_fc <- top_table_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Comparisons %in% c(
        paste0("H_", comparison_label),
        paste0("C_", comparison_label)
      )
    )

  df_dir <- df_fc %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Species = ifelse(grepl("^H_", Comparisons), "H", "C")) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Gene, Species) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(logFC = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = logFC) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(H), !is.na(C)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # ---------------------------
  # KEY FILTER: DEGs in BOTH species
  # ---------------------------
  if (!is.null(gene_set)) {
    df_dir <- df_dir %>%
      dplyr::filter(Gene %in% gene_set)
  }

  # ---------------------------
  # direction classification
  # ---------------------------
  df_combo <- df_dir %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      direction = dplyr::case_when(
        H > 0 & C < 0 ~ "H_pos_C_neg",
        H < 0 & C > 0 ~ "H_neg_C_pos",
        H > 0 & C > 0 ~ "Both_pos",
        H < 0 & C < 0 ~ "Both_neg",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      direction_group = dplyr::case_when(
        H * C > 0 ~ "Same_direction",
        H * C < 0 ~ "Opposite_direction",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )

  # ---------------------------
  # output
  # ---------------------------
  list(
    all = df_combo,
    H_pos_C_neg = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "H_pos_C_neg"),
    H_neg_C_pos = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "H_neg_C_pos"),
    Both_pos = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "Both_pos"),
    Both_neg = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "Both_neg"),

    Same_direction = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction_group == "Same_direction"),
    Opposite_direction = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction_group == "Opposite_direction"),

    Other = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "Other"),

    n_sig = length(gene_set)
  )
}

#get_directional_genes_HvC1

get_fc_directions_HvC <- function(traj_label, coef_name, comparison_label,
                                 top_table_all, fit_obj, p_cutoff = 0.05) {

  # ---------------------------
  # DE genes
  # ---------------------------
  tt <- topTable(fit_obj, coef = coef_name, number = Inf)

  sig_tt <- tt %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < p_cutoff) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # ---------------------------
  # HvC FC data
  # ---------------------------
  df_fc <- top_table_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(Comparisons == comparison_label) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # ---------------------------
  # classify direction
  # ---------------------------
  df_combo <- df_fc %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(sig_tt, by = "Gene") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      logFC.x > 0 ~ "Human_higher",
      logFC.x < 0 ~ "Chimp_higher",
      TRUE ~ "No_difference"
    ),
    magnitude = abs(logFC.x)
  )

  # ---------------------------
  # output
  # ---------------------------
  list(
    all = df_combo,
    Human_higher = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "Human_higher"),
    Chimp_higher = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "Chimp_higher"),
    n_sig = nrow(sig_tt)
  )
}

#go_enrichment

Enrich_Go_sets <- function(gene_sets, v) {

  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(dplyr)

  background_genes <- rownames(v$E) %>%
    sub("\\..*", "", .) %>%
    unique()

  run_go <- function(genes) {

    genes <- unique(sub("\\..*", "", genes))
    genes <- intersect(genes, background_genes)

    if (length(genes) < 10) return(NULL)

    ego <- enrichGO(
      gene          = genes,
      universe      = background_genes,
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      keyType       = "ENSEMBL",
      ont           = "BP",
      readable      = TRUE,
      pvalueCutoff  = 1,
      qvalueCutoff  = 1
    )

    if (is.null(ego)) return(NULL)

    as.data.frame(ego)
  }

  run_kegg <- function(genes) {

    genes <- unique(sub("\\..*", "", genes))
    genes <- intersect(genes, background_genes)

    if (length(genes) < 10) return(NULL)

    # Convert Ensembl IDs to Entrez IDs for KEGG
    gene_conversion <- bitr(
      genes,
      fromType = "ENSEMBL",
      toType   = "ENTREZID",
      OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
    )

    background_conversion <- bitr(
      background_genes,
      fromType = "ENSEMBL",
      toType   = "ENTREZID",
      OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
    )

    if (is.null(gene_conversion) || nrow(gene_conversion) < 10 ||
        is.null(background_conversion) || nrow(background_conversion) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    ekegg <- enrichKEGG(
      gene          = unique(gene_conversion$ENTREZID),
      universe      = unique(background_conversion$ENTREZID),
      organism      = "hsa",
      pvalueCutoff  = 1,
      qvalueCutoff  = 1
    )

    if (is.null(ekegg)) return(NULL)

    as.data.frame(ekegg)
  }

  results <- lapply(gene_sets, function(df) {

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(list(GO = NULL, KEGG = NULL))
    }

    list(
      GO   = run_go(df$Gene),
      KEGG = run_kegg(df$Gene)
    )
  })

  return(results)
}


plot_KZFP_interaction <- function(
    gene_set,
    top_table
) {

  plot_data <- top_table %>%
    filter(Gene %in% gene_set) %>%
    mutate(
      Transition = recode(
        Comparisons,
        "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj02" = "Day0-2",
        "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj25" = "Day2-5",
        "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj515" = "Day5-15",
        "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj1530" = "Day15-30"
      ),
      Transition = factor(
        Transition,
        levels = c("Day0-2", "Day2-5", "Day5-15", "Day15-30")
      )
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Transition,
      y = logFC,
      group = Gene
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "Differentiation transition",
      y = "Interaction logFC"
    )
}
```

### DGE
```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_Contrasts}
fit <- readRDS("data/DGE/fit_logcpm_G1_SpTp_All_NoRep.RDS")
design_int <- readRDS("data/DGE/design_int_logcpm_G1_SpTp_All_NoRep.RDS")

contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(

  # Species differences
  HvC_Day0  = SpeciesH,
  HvC_Day2  = SpeciesH + SpeciesH.TimepointDay2,
  HvC_Day4  = SpeciesH + SpeciesH.TimepointDay4,
  HvC_Day5  = SpeciesH + SpeciesH.TimepointDay5,
  HvC_Day15 = SpeciesH + SpeciesH.TimepointDay15,
  HvC_Day30 = SpeciesH + SpeciesH.TimepointDay30,
  
  #Trajectory differences
  H_Day02 = TimepointDay2 + SpeciesH.TimepointDay2,
  H_Day24 = TimepointDay4 + SpeciesH.TimepointDay4 - TimepointDay2 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay2,
  H_Day45 = TimepointDay5 + SpeciesH.TimepointDay5 - TimepointDay4 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay4,
  H_Day515 = TimepointDay15 + SpeciesH.TimepointDay15 - TimepointDay5 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay5,
  H_Day1530 = TimepointDay30 + SpeciesH.TimepointDay30 - TimepointDay15 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay15,
  C_Day02 = TimepointDay2,
  C_Day24 = TimepointDay4 - TimepointDay2,
  C_Day45 = TimepointDay5 - TimepointDay4,
  C_Day515 = TimepointDay15 - TimepointDay5,
  C_Day1530 = TimepointDay30 - TimepointDay15,
  
  # True interaction tests trajectory
  Sig_Sp_inter_Traj02 = SpeciesH.TimepointDay2,
  Sig_Sp_inter_Traj24 = SpeciesH.TimepointDay4 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay2,
  Sig_Sp_inter_Traj45 = SpeciesH.TimepointDay5 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay4,
  Sig_Sp_inter_Traj515 = SpeciesH.TimepointDay15 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay5,
  Sig_Sp_inter_Traj1530 = SpeciesH.TimepointDay30 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay15,
  
  levels = design_int
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

plotSA(fit2, main = "RNA Model")

results_summary <- decideTests(fit2,
                               adjust.method = "BH",
                               p.value = 0.05)
summary(results_summary)

# saveRDS(fit2, "data/DGE/fit2_logcpm_G1_SpTp_All_NoRep.RDS")
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_TopTable}
fit2 <- readRDS("data/DGE/fit2_logcpm_G1_SpTp_All_NoRep.RDS")

#Create Human TopTable. using listapply, then you can pull specific comp using the $
TopTables_RNA_names <- colnames(fit2$coefficients) 

TopTable_RNA_All <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(TopTables_RNA_names,function(ct) {
    
    tt <- topTable(
      fit2,
      coef = ct,
      number = Inf,
      sort.by = "p"
    )
    
    #add identifiers
    tt$Gene <- rownames(tt)
    tt$Comparisons <- ct
    
    tt
  })
)

ComparisonNames <- unique(TopTable_RNA_All$Comparisons)

# saveRDS(TopTable_RNA_All, "data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_All_NoRep.RDS")

head(TopTable_RNA_All)
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_VolcanoPlots}
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_All_NoRep.RDS")
ComparisonNames <- readRDS("data/DGE/ComparisonNames_logcpm_G1_SpTp_All_NoRep.RDS")

# Calculate global axis limits
x_limits <- range(TopTable$logFC, na.rm = TRUE)
y_limits <- range(-log10(TopTable$P.Value), na.rm = TRUE)

plot <- list()

for (n in ComparisonNames) {
  data_n <- TopTable %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Comparisons == n)
  
  plot[[n]] <- generate_volcano_plot(data_n, n) +
    ggplot2::xlim(x_limits) +
    ggplot2::ylim(y_limits)
}

# Print plots
for (n in ComparisonNames) {
  print(plot[[n]])
}
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_Interactions_Directions}
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_All_NoRep.RDS")
ComparisonNames <- readRDS("data/DGE/ComparisonNames_logcpm_G1_SpTp_All_NoRep.RDS")
RNA_sets <- readRDS("data/DGE/RNAsets_logcpm_G1_SpTp_All_NoRep.RDS")
fit2 <- readRDS("data/DGE/fit2_logcpm_G1_SpTp_All_NoRep.RDS")

traj_info <- list(
  InterTraj02 = list(coef = "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj02", comp = "Day02"),
  InterTraj24 = list(coef = "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj24", comp = "Day24"),
  InterTraj45 = list(coef = "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj45", comp = "Day45"),
  InterTraj515 = list(coef = "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj515", comp = "Day515"),
  InterTraj1530 = list(coef = "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj1530", comp = "Day1530")
)

cluster_lists <- list(
  InterTraj02  = Inter_02_genes,
  InterTraj24  = Inter_24_genes,
  InterTraj45  = Inter_45_genes,
  InterTraj515 = Inter_515_genes,
  InterTraj1530 = Inter_1530_genes
)

direction_results <- setNames(
  lapply(names(traj_info), function(name) {

    info <- traj_info[[name]]

    get_fc_directions(
      traj_label = name,
      coef_name = info$coef,
      comparison_label = info$comp,
      top_table_all = TopTable,
      fit_obj = fit2,
      gene_set = cluster_lists[[name]]
    )

  }),
  names(traj_info)
)
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4}
  col = pal[as.numeric(as.factor(metadata$Timepoint[human_idx]))],
  main = "",
  legend = FALSE,
  axes = FALSE
)

axis(1)
axis(2)
mtext("log2 CPM", side = 1, line = 2)

title("Chimp")
  legend(
      "right",
      legend = metadata$Individual[chimp_idx],  # or Timepoint, etc.
      col = rainbow(sum(chimp_idx)),
      lty = 1,
     cex = 0.7
    )

species_levels <- unique(metadata$Species)
day_levels <- unique(metadata$Timepoint)

for (sp in species_levels) {
  for (day in day_levels) {

    idx <- metadata$Species == sp &
           metadata$Timepoint == day

    if (sum(idx) > 0) {

      cols <- rainbow(sum(idx))

      plotDensities(
        v2[, idx],
        col = cols,
        main = paste(sp, day),
        legend = FALSE,
        axes = FALSE
      )

      axis(1)
      axis(2)
      mtext("log2 CPM", side = 1, line = 2)

      legend(
        "right",
        legend = metadata$Individual[idx],
        col = cols,
        lty = 1,
        cex = 0.7
      )
    }
  }
}
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_contrasts}
fit <- readRDS("data/DGE/fit_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")
design_int <- readRDS("data/DGE/design_int_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")


contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(

  # Species differences
  HvC_Day0  = SpeciesH,
  HvC_Day2  = SpeciesH + SpeciesH.TimepointDay2,
  HvC_Day5  = SpeciesH + SpeciesH.TimepointDay5,
  HvC_Day15 = SpeciesH + SpeciesH.TimepointDay15,
  HvC_Day30 = SpeciesH + SpeciesH.TimepointDay30,
  
  #Trajectory differences
  H_Day02 = TimepointDay2 + SpeciesH.TimepointDay2,
  H_Day25 = TimepointDay5 + SpeciesH.TimepointDay5 - TimepointDay2 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay2,
  H_Day515 = TimepointDay15 + SpeciesH.TimepointDay15 - TimepointDay5 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay5,
  H_Day1530 = TimepointDay30 + SpeciesH.TimepointDay30 - TimepointDay15 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay15,
  C_Day02 = TimepointDay2,
  C_Day25 = TimepointDay5 - TimepointDay2,
  C_Day515 = TimepointDay15 - TimepointDay5,
  C_Day1530 = TimepointDay30 - TimepointDay15,
  
  # True interaction tests trajectory
  Sig_Sp_inter_Traj02 = SpeciesH.TimepointDay2,
  Sig_Sp_inter_Traj25 = SpeciesH.TimepointDay5 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay2,
  Sig_Sp_inter_Traj515 = SpeciesH.TimepointDay15 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay5,
  Sig_Sp_inter_Traj1530 = SpeciesH.TimepointDay30 - SpeciesH.TimepointDay15,
  
  levels = design_int
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

plotSA(fit2, main = "RNA Model")

results_summary <- decideTests(fit2,
                               adjust.method = "BH",
                               p.value = 0.05)
summary(results_summary)

# saveRDS(fit2, "data/DGE/fit2_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_TopTable}
fit2 <- readRDS("data/DGE/fit2_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

#Create Human TopTable. using listapply, then you can pull specific comp using the $
TopTables_RNA_names <- colnames(fit2$coefficients) 

TopTable_RNA_All <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(TopTables_RNA_names,function(ct) {
    
    tt <- topTable(
      fit2,
      coef = ct,
      number = Inf,
      sort.by = "p"
    )
    
    #add identifiers
    tt$Gene <- rownames(tt)
    tt$Comparisons <- ct
    
    tt
  })
)

ComparisonNames <- unique(TopTable_RNA_All$Comparisons)
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Species_Proportions, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)

species <- c(
  "HvC_Day0","HvC_Day2","HvC_Day5","HvC_Day15","HvC_Day30"
)

# 1. Filter + define DEG status
df <- TopTable %>%
  filter(Comparisons %in% species) %>%
  mutate(DEG_status = ifelse(adj.P.Val < 0.05, "DEG", "Non-DEG"))

# 2. Summarise proportions per comparison
prop_df <- df %>%
  group_by(Comparisons, DEG_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Comparisons) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. Order comparisons properly
prop_df$Comparisons <- factor(
  prop_df$Comparisons,
  levels = c(
    "HvC_Day0","HvC_Day2","HvC_Day5","HvC_Day15","HvC_Day30"
  )
)

# 4. Plot
library(ggplot2)

prop_df$DEG_status <- factor(
  prop_df$DEG_status,
  levels = c("DEG", "Non-DEG")
)

ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = Comparisons, y = prop, fill = DEG_status)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Proportion of genes",
    fill = "",
    title = "DEG vs Non-DEG composition"
  )

ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = Comparisons, y = prop, fill = DEG_status)) +
  geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Species_Proportions2, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")
ComparisonNames <- readRDS("data/DGE/ComparisonNames_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(purrr)
library(stringr)

hvcdays <- names(RNA_sets)[str_detect(names(RNA_sets), "^HvC_")]

  x <- RNA_sets[[traj]]
  
  tibble(
    trajectory = traj,
    DEG = length(x$DEGs$Gene),
    NonDEG = length(x$NonDEGs$Gene)
  )
})
library(tidyr)

prop_long <- prop_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(DEG, NonDEG),
               names_to = "type",
               values_to = "count") %>%
  group_by(trajectory) %>%
  mutate(prop = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()
prop_long$trajectory <- factor(
  prop_long$trajectory,
  levels = c("HvC_Day0", "HvC_Day2", "HvC_Day5", "HvC_Day15", "HvC_Day30"),
  labels = c("0", "2", "5", "15", "30")
)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(prop_long, aes(x = trajectory, y = prop, fill = type)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Proportion of genes",
    fill = "",
    title = "HvC comparisons: DEG vs NonDEG composition"
  )
```

```{r  RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Species_Proportions3, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}

TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Extract HvC DEGs
df <- TopTable %>%
  filter(str_detect(Comparisons, "^HvC_Day")) %>%
  mutate(
    Stage = str_extract(Comparisons, "Day[0-9]+"),
    DEG = adj.P.Val < 0.05
  ) %>%
  filter(DEG)


# Create DEG gene lists by developmental day
genes <- list(
  Day0  = df %>% filter(Stage == "Day0")  %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day2  = df %>% filter(Stage == "Day2")  %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day5  = df %>% filter(Stage == "Day5")  %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day15 = df %>% filter(Stage == "Day15") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day30 = df %>% filter(Stage == "Day30") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique()
)

days <- names(genes)

# Genes DE at every developmental stage
shared_all <- Reduce(intersect, genes)


############################################################
# Determine DEG fate categories and save gene identities
############################################################


fate_list <- lapply(names(genes), function(day) {

  g <- genes[[day]]

  Stage_specific <- setdiff(g, unlist(genes[names(genes) != day]))

  All_stage <- intersect(g, shared_all)

  Multi_stage <- setdiff(
    setdiff(g, Stage_specific),
    All_stage
  )

  data.frame(
    Gene = c(
      Stage_specific,
      All_stage,
      Multi_stage
    ),
    Day = day,
    Fate = c(
      rep("Stage_specific", length(Stage_specific)),
      rep("Multi_stage", length(Multi_stage)),
      rep("All_stage", length(All_stage))
    )
  )
})

fate_df <- bind_rows(fate_list)

saveRDS(fate_df, "data/DGE/SpeciesFateDf_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

fate_df <- readRDS("data/DGE/SpeciesFateDf_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

############################################################
# Extract actual TopTable rows for each fate category
############################################################

TopTable_HvC_DEG_Fate <- TopTable %>%
  filter(str_detect(Comparisons, "^HvC_Day")) %>%
  mutate(
    Day = str_extract(Comparisons, "Day[0-9]+")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    fate_df,
    by = c("Gene", "Day")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Fate))


# Split into separate TopTables
TopTable_Specific <- TopTable_HvC_DEG_Fate %>%
  filter(Fate == "Stage_specific")

TopTable_Shared_partial <- TopTable_HvC_DEG_Fate %>%
  filter(Fate == "Multi_stage")

TopTable_Shared_all <- TopTable_HvC_DEG_Fate %>%
  filter(Fate == "All_stage")


saveRDS(TopTable_HvC_DEG_Fate, "data/DGE/SpeciesFateTopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

TopTable_HvC_DEG_Fate <-readRDS("data/DGE/SpeciesFateTopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

############################################################
# Plot counts
############################################################

plot_df <- fate_df %>%
  dplyr::count(Day, name = "Count") %>%
  mutate(
    Day = factor(
      Day,
      levels = c("Day0", "Day2", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")
    )
  )

col_theme <- ann_colors$timepoint_cor

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Day, y = Count, fill = Day)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_theme) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Developmental stage",
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    title = "HvC DEGs across development"
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none")
plot_df <- fate_df %>%
  dplyr::count(Day, Fate, name = "Count") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Fate,
    values_from = Count,
    values_fill = 0
  )

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Stage_specific, Multi_stage, All_stage),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Day = factor(
      Day,
      levels = c("Day0", "Day2", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")
    ),
    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = c("Stage_specific", "Multi_stage", "All_stage"),
      labels = c("Stage-specific", "Multi-stage", "All-stage")
    )
  )

category_colors <- c(
  "Stage-specific" = "#D55E00",
  "Multi-stage" = "#0072B2",
  "All-stage" = "#009E73"
)

plot_df <- fate_df %>%
  dplyr::count(Day, Fate, name = "Count") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Fate,
    values_from = Count,
    values_fill = 0
  )

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Stage_specific, Multi_stage, All_stage),
    names_to = "Category",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Day = factor(
      Day,
      levels = c("Day0", "Day2", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")
    ),
    Category = factor(
      Category,
      levels = c("Stage_specific", "Multi_stage", "All_stage"),
      labels = c("Stage-specific", "Multi-stage", "All-stage")
    )
  )

category_colors <- c(
  "Stage-specific" = "#D55E00",
  "Multi-stage" = "#0072B2",
  "All-stage" = "#009E73"
)

# Plot DEG counts
ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = Day, y = Count, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = category_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Developmental stage",
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    fill = NULL,
    title = "Fate of HvC DEGs across development"
  )

# Plot DEG proportions
plot_long_prop <- plot_long %>%
  group_by(Day) %>%
  mutate(Prop = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(plot_long_prop, aes(x = Day, y = Prop, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = category_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent()
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Developmental stage",
    y = "Proportion of DEGs",
    fill = NULL,

  )
```

#### Proportions

```{r  RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Stage_Proportions, fig.width=4, fig.height=6}
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)

traj <- c(
  "H_Day02","H_Day25","H_Day515","H_Day1530",
  "C_Day02","C_Day25","C_Day515","C_Day1530"
)

# 1. Filter + define DEG status
df <- TopTable %>%
  filter(Comparisons %in% traj) %>%
  mutate(DEG_status = ifelse(adj.P.Val < 0.05, "DEG", "Non-DEG"))

# 2. Summarise proportions per comparison
prop_df <- df %>%
  group_by(Comparisons, DEG_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Comparisons) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. Order comparisons properly
prop_df$Comparisons <- factor(
  prop_df$Comparisons,
  levels = c(
    "H_Day02","H_Day25","H_Day515","H_Day1530",
    "C_Day02","C_Day25","C_Day515","C_Day1530"
  )
)

# 4. Plot
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = Comparisons, y = prop, fill = DEG_status)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Proportion of genes",
    fill = "",
    title = "DEG vs NonDEG composition"
  )

ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = Comparisons, y = n, fill = DEG_status)) +
  geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(
  filter(prop_df, DEG_status == "DEG"),
  aes(x = Comparisons, y = n)
) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    title = "Transition DEGs"
  )
prop_df %>% 
  filter(DEG_status == "DEG")

ggplot(
  prop_df %>%
    filter(DEG_status == "DEG") %>%
    mutate(
      Species = ifelse(grepl("^H_", Comparisons), "Human", "Chimpanzee"),
      Comparisons = sub("^[HC]_", "", as.character(Comparisons)),
      Comparisons = factor(
        Comparisons,
        levels = c("Day02", "Day25", "Day515", "Day1530")
      ),
      Species = factor(Species, levels = c("Human", "Chimpanzee"))
    ),
  aes(x = Comparisons, y = n)
) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ Species, ncol = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    title = "Transition DEGs"
  )
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Stage_Proportions2, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

traj_levels <- c("H_Day02","H_Day25","H_Day515","H_Day1530",
                 "C_Day02","C_Day25","C_Day515","C_Day1530")

df <- TopTable %>%
  dplyr::filter(Comparisons %in% traj_levels)

df <- df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species = ifelse(grepl("^H", Comparisons), "Human", "Chimp"),
    Stage = sub(".*_(Day[0-9]+)", "\\1", Comparisons),
    DEG = adj.P.Val < 0.05
  )

df_deg <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(DEG)

library(dplyr)

df_deg2 <- df_deg %>%
  group_by(Gene, Stage, Species) %>%
  summarise(.groups = "drop")

df_overlap <- df_deg2 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Species,
    values_from = Gene,
    values_fn = length,
    values_fill = 0
  )

df_flags <- df_deg2 %>%
  mutate(flag = TRUE) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Species,
    values_from = flag,
    values_fill = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = case_when(
      Human & Chimp ~ "Shared",
      Human ~ "Human only",
      Chimp ~ "Chimp only"
    )
  )

plot_df <- df_flags %>%
  group_by(Stage, category) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Stage) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) 

plot_df$Stage <- factor(
  plot_df$Stage,
  levels = c("Day02", "Day25", "Day515", "Day1530")
)

library(ggpattern)

    pattern_density = 0.4,
    pattern_spacing = 0.02
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Shared" = "grey70",
    "Human only" = "black",
    "Chimp only" = "white"
  )) +

  scale_pattern_manual(values = c(
    "Shared" = "stripe",
    "Human only" = "none",
    "Chimp only" = "none"
  )) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Developmental Stage",

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Stage, y = n, fill = category)) +
```

#### Effect Sizes
```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Stage_EffectSize}
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")
RNA_sets <- readRDS("data/DGE/RNAsets_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ----------------------------
# 1. Define trajectories
# ----------------------------
traj <- c(
  "H_Day02","H_Day25","H_Day515","H_Day1530",
  "C_Day02","C_Day25","C_Day515","C_Day1530"
)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Prepare long data
# ----------------------------
df <- TopTable %>%
  filter(Comparisons %in% traj) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = ifelse(str_detect(Comparisons, "^H"), "Human", "Chimp"),
    Stage = str_extract(Comparisons, "Day[0-9]+"),
    DEG = adj.P.Val < 0.05
  )

# ----------------------------
# 3. Collapse to gene-level (keep all DEGs in either species)
# ----------------------------
df_wide <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Species, Stage, logFC, DEG) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Species,
    values_from = c(logFC, DEG)
  )

df_deg <- df_wide %>%
  filter(DEG_Human | DEG_Chimp)   # ALL DEGs (union)

# ----------------------------
# 4. Build plotting dataset
# ----------------------------
plot_df <- df_deg %>%
  mutate(
    logFC_H = abs(logFC_Human),
    logFC_C = abs(logFC_Chimp)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Stage, logFC_H, logFC_C) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(logFC_H, logFC_C),
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "abs_logFC"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = ifelse(Species == "logFC_H", "Human", "Chimp"),
    Stage = factor(Stage, levels = c("Day02","Day25","Day515","Day1530"))
  )

# ----------------------------
# 5. Plot
# ----------------------------
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Species, y = abs_logFC, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Stage, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human" = "black",
    "Chimp" = "white"
  )) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "|logFC| (all DEGs)",
    title = "Effect sizes across all DEGs"
  )
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Stage_EffectSize2}
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ----------------------------
# 1. Define trajectories
# ----------------------------
traj <- c(
  "H_Day02","H_Day25","H_Day515","H_Day1530",
  "C_Day02","C_Day25","C_Day515","C_Day1530"
)

# ----------------------------
# 2. Prepare long data
# ----------------------------
df <- TopTable %>%
  filter(Comparisons %in% traj) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = ifelse(str_detect(Comparisons, "^H"), "Human", "Chimp"),
    Stage = str_extract(Comparisons, "Day[0-9]+"),
    DEG = adj.P.Val < 0.05
  )

# ----------------------------
# 3. Collapse to gene-level
# ----------------------------
df_wide <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Species, Stage, logFC, DEG) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Species,
    values_from = c(logFC, DEG)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 4. Build species-specific DEG sets
# ----------------------------
plot_df <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    use_H = DEG_Human,   # Human uses its DEGs (shared + human-only)
    use_C = DEG_Chimp    # Chimp uses its DEGs (shared + chimp-only)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Stage,
         logFC_Human, logFC_Chimp,
         use_H, use_C) %>%
  
  # reshape manually into long format
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(logFC_Human, logFC_Chimp),
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "logFC"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    use = ifelse(
      Species == "logFC_Human", use_H,
      use_C
    ),
    Species = ifelse(Species == "logFC_Human", "Human", "Chimp")
  ) %>%
  
  filter(use) %>%   # keep only DEGs for that species
  
  mutate(
    abs_logFC = abs(logFC),
    Stage = factor(Stage, levels = c("Day02","Day25","Day515","Day1530"))
  )

# ----------------------------
# 5. Plot
# ----------------------------
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Species, y = abs_logFC, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Stage, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human" = "black",
    "Chimp" = "white"
  )) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "|logFC| (species-specific DEGs)",
    title = "Effect sizes within each species' DEG set"
  )
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Stage_EffectSize3}
)
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Stage_EffectSize4}
  mutate(
    logFC_H = abs(logFC_H),

  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Stage, logFC_H, logFC_C) %>%

    cols = c(logFC_H, logFC_C),
    names_to = "Species",
    values_to = "abs_logFC"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = ifelse(Species == "logFC_H", "Human", "Chimp"),
    Stage = factor(Stage, levels = c("Day02","Day25","Day515","Day1530"))
  )

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Species, y = abs_logFC, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Stage, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Human" = "black",
    "Chimp" = "white"
  )) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "|logFC| (DEGs in both species)",
    title = "Conserved Trajectory DEG effect sizes across development"
  )
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Stage_Go2}
fit2 <- readRDS("data/DGE/fit2_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

v <- readRDS("data/DGE/v1_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")


df <- TopTable

times <- c(
  "H_Day02", "H_Day25", "H_Day515", "H_Day1530",
  "C_Day02", "C_Day25", "C_Day515", "C_Day1530"
)

# Existing sets: all significant DEGs for each species and transition
gene_sets <- setNames(
  lapply(times, function(x) {
    df %>%
      filter(Comparisons == x, adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
      distinct(Gene)
  }),
  times
)

# Add shared and species-specific DEG sets
stages <- c("Day02", "Day25", "Day515", "Day1530")

for (stage in stages) {

  human_genes <- gene_sets[[paste0("H_", stage)]]$Gene
  chimp_genes <- gene_sets[[paste0("C_", stage)]]$Gene

  gene_sets[[paste0(stage, "_Shared")]] <-
    data.frame(Gene = intersect(human_genes, chimp_genes))

  gene_sets[[paste0(stage, "_Honly")]] <-
    data.frame(Gene = setdiff(human_genes, chimp_genes))

  gene_sets[[paste0(stage, "_Conly")]] <-
    data.frame(Gene = setdiff(chimp_genes, human_genes))
}

# Check group sizes
data.frame(
  GeneSet = names(gene_sets),
  n_genes = sapply(gene_sets, nrow)
)

# Run GO enrichment on all sets
all_go_results <- Enrich_Go_sets(gene_sets, v)
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Stage_Go3,fig.height=10,fig.height=10}
TrajectoryGo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep <- readRDS("data/DGE/TrajectoryGo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

comparison <- c(
    "Traj02_genes","Traj25_genes","Traj515_genes","Traj1530_genes"
  )

top10_terms <- imap_dfr(
  TrajectoryGo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep,
  function(comp_list, comparison) {

    imap_dfr(
      comp_list,
      function(go_df, gene_set) {

        if (is.null(go_df) || nrow(go_df) == 0)
          return(NULL)

        go_df %>%
          filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
          arrange(p.adjust) %>%
          slice_head(n = 10) %>%
          dplyr::select(ID, Description) %>%
          mutate(
            Comparison = comparison,
            GeneSet = gene_set
          )
      }
    )
  }
)

GO_terms_to_plot <- top10_terms %>%
  distinct(GeneSet, Description)

GO_plot_data <- imap_dfr(
 TrajectoryGo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep,
  function(comp_list, comparison) {

    imap_dfr(
      comp_list,
      function(go_df, gene_set) {

        if (is.null(go_df) || nrow(go_df) == 0)
          return(NULL)

        go_df %>%
          filter(
            Description %in% GO_terms_to_plot$Description[
              GO_terms_to_plot$GeneSet == gene_set
            ]
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            Comparison = comparison,
            GeneSet = gene_set
          )
      }
    )
  }
)


GO_plot_data$Comparison <- factor(
  GO_plot_data$Comparison,
  levels = c(
    "Traj02_genes","Traj25_genes","Traj515_genes","Traj1530_genes")
)

GO_plot_data$Description <- factor(
  GO_plot_data$Description,
  levels = rev(unique(top10_terms$Description))
)
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Stage_GoPlotting3, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

# all_go_results <- readRDS(
#   "data/DGE/TrajectoryGo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS"
# )

sig_thresh <- 0.05

comparisons <- c(
  "Traj02_genes",
  "Traj25_genes",
  "Traj515_genes",
  "Traj1530_genes"
)

categories <- c(
  "Same_direction",
  "Opposite_direction",
  "All"
)

# ============================================================
# Extract top significant GO terms for each category
# ============================================================

get_go_data <- function(category) {

  bind_rows(lapply(comparisons, function(comp) {

    df <- all_go_results[[comp]][[category]]

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      filter(!is.na(p.adjust), p.adjust < sig_thresh) %>%
      arrange(p.adjust) %>%
      slice_head(n = 5) %>%
      transmute(
        Comparison = comp,
        term_name = Description,
        p.adjust = p.adjust
      )
  }))
}


# ============================================================
# Make one heatmap
# ============================================================

make_go_heatmap <- function(category) {

  top_terms <- get_go_data(category)

  if (is.null(top_terms) || nrow(top_terms) == 0) {
    message("No significant GO terms for: ", category)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  unique_terms <- unique(top_terms$term_name)

  # Re-extract selected terms across all comparisons
  heatmap_data <- bind_rows(lapply(comparisons, function(comp) {

    df <- all_go_results[[comp]][[category]]

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      filter(
        Description %in% unique_terms,
        !is.na(p.adjust),
        p.adjust < sig_thresh
      ) %>%
      transmute(
        Comparison = comp,
        term_name = Description,
        logp = -log10(p.adjust)
      )
  })) %>%
    group_by(Comparison, term_name) %>%
    summarise(
      logp = max(logp, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  if (nrow(heatmap_data) == 0) {
    message("No plot data for: ", category)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Create complete term-by-comparison grid
  heatmap_wide <- heatmap_data %>%
    dplyr::select(term_name, Comparison, logp) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Comparison,
      values_from = logp
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(term_name, any_of(comparisons))

  # Save wide data
  saveRDS(
    heatmap_wide,
    paste0(
      "data/Cormotif/Species/",
      category,
      "GoWide_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS"
    )
  )

  # Prepare numeric matrix
  heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_wide %>%
    column_to_rownames("term_name") %>%
    as.matrix()

  storage.mode(heatmap_matrix) <- "numeric"
  heatmap_matrix[!is.finite(heatmap_matrix)] <- 0

  # Remove rows with no variation if row clustering cannot use them
  if (nrow(heatmap_matrix) > 1) {
    keep_rows <- apply(heatmap_matrix, 1, function(x) {
      length(unique(x)) > 1
    })

    # Keep all rows if every row is constant; pheatmap can still
    # display them when clustering is disabled.
    if (any(keep_rows)) {
      heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }

  if (nrow(heatmap_matrix) == 0 || ncol(heatmap_matrix) == 0) {
    message("No variable heatmap rows for: ", category)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Significance labels aligned to the plotted matrix
  sig_matrix <- ifelse(heatmap_matrix > -log10(sig_thresh), "*", "")
  dimnames(sig_matrix) <- dimnames(heatmap_matrix)

  # Ensure color breaks are unique, including for constant matrices
  value_range <- range(heatmap_matrix, finite = TRUE)

  if (diff(value_range) == 0) {
    value_range <- value_range + c(-0.5, 0.5)
  }

  breaks <- seq(
    value_range[1],
    value_range[2],
    length.out = 101
  )

  pheatmap(
    heatmap_matrix,
    breaks = breaks,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "firebrick"))(100),
    cluster_rows = nrow(heatmap_matrix) > 1,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 6,
    fontsize_col = 8,
    main = paste("GO:BP Enrichment -", category),
    display_numbers = sig_matrix,
    number_color = "black"
  )
}


# ============================================================
# Generate heatmaps
# ============================================================

make_go_heatmap("All")
make_go_heatmap("Same_direction")
make_go_heatmap("Opposite_direction")
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Stage_GoPlotting4, fig.width= 10, fig.height=10}

all_pathway_results <- readRDS("data/DGE/TrajectoryGo_subsetting_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

sig_thresh <- 0.05

comparisons <- c(
  "H_Day02", "C_Day02", "Day02_S", "Day02_H", "Day02_C",
  "H_Day25", "C_Day25", "Day25_S", "Day25_H", "Day25_C",
  "H_Day515", "C_Day515", "Day515_S", "Day515_H", "Day515_C",
  "H_Day1530", "C_Day1530", "Day1530_S", "Day1530_H", "Day1530_C"
)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)


# Extract the top five terms per comparison
get_pathway_data <- function(pathway = "GO") {

  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(comparisons, function(comp) {

    result <- all_pathway_results[[comp]]

    if (is.null(result) || !is.list(result)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df <- result[[pathway]]

    if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(p.adjust)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
      dplyr::slice_head(n = 5) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        Comparison = comp,
        term_name = Description,
        p.adjust = p.adjust
      )
  }))
}


# Create a GO or KEGG heatmap
make_pathway_heatmap <- function(pathway = "GO") {

  if (!pathway %in% c("GO", "KEGG")) {
    stop("pathway must be either 'GO' or 'KEGG'.")
  }

  top_terms <- get_pathway_data(pathway)

  if (is.null(top_terms) || nrow(top_terms) == 0) {
    message("No ", pathway, " terms found.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  unique_terms <- unique(top_terms$term_name)

  # Gather selected terms across all comparisons
  heatmap_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(comparisons, function(comp) {

    result <- all_pathway_results[[comp]]

    if (is.null(result) || !is.list(result)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df <- result[[pathway]]

    if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Description %in% unique_terms,
        !is.na(p.adjust)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        Comparison = comp,
        term_name = Description,
        p.adjust = p.adjust,
        logp = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)),
        sig = ifelse(p.adjust < sig_thresh, "*", "")
      )
  }))

  if (nrow(heatmap_data) == 0) {
    message("No ", pathway, " results available for the selected terms.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Handle duplicate term/comparison combinations
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Comparison, term_name) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      logp = max(logp, na.rm = TRUE),
      sig = if (any(sig == "*")) "*" else "",
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Create numeric heatmap matrix
  heatmap_wide <- heatmap_data %>%
    dplyr::select(term_name, Comparison, logp) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = Comparison,
      values_from = logp
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(term_name, dplyr::any_of(comparisons))

  # Create significance annotation matrix
  sig_wide <- heatmap_data %>%
    dplyr::select(term_name, Comparison, sig) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = Comparison,
      values_from = sig,
      values_fill = ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(term_name, dplyr::any_of(comparisons))

  # Save the numeric heatmap values
  saveRDS(
    heatmap_wide,
    paste0(
      "data/DGE/",
      pathway,
      "_SharedSpecificWide_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS"
    )
  )

  # Convert to matrices
  heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_wide %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("term_name") %>%
    as.matrix()

  sig_matrix <- sig_wide %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("term_name") %>%
    as.matrix()

  storage.mode(heatmap_matrix) <- "numeric"
  heatmap_matrix[!is.finite(heatmap_matrix)] <- NA_real_
  sig_matrix[is.na(sig_matrix)] <- ""

  # Remove rows with no usable values
  keep_rows <- rowSums(!is.na(heatmap_matrix)) > 0

  heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
  sig_matrix <- sig_matrix[rownames(heatmap_matrix), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(heatmap_matrix) == 0) {
    message("No finite enrichment values to plot.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Define colour scale
  value_range <- range(heatmap_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (diff(value_range) == 0) {
    value_range <- value_range + c(-0.5, 0.5)
  }

  # Plot heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_matrix,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "firebrick"))(100),
    breaks = seq(value_range[1], value_range[2], length.out = 101),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 6,
    fontsize_col = 8,
    angle_col = 45,
    main = if (pathway == "GO") {
      "GO:BP Enrichment — Shared and Species-Specific DEGs"
    } else {
      "KEGG Enrichment — Shared and Species-Specific DEGs"
    },
    display_numbers = sig_matrix,
    number_color = "black",
    na_col = "white"
  )
}


# Generate separate heatmaps
make_pathway_heatmap("GO")
make_pathway_heatmap("KEGG")


```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Stage_GoPlotting5, fig.width= 4, fig.height=5}
    as.matrix()

  storage.mode(heatmap_matrix) <- "numeric"
  heatmap_matrix[!is.finite(heatmap_matrix)] <- NA_real_
  sig_matrix[is.na(sig_matrix)] <- ""

  # Remove rows with no usable values
  keep_rows <- rowSums(!is.na(heatmap_matrix)) > 0

  heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
  sig_matrix <- sig_matrix[rownames(heatmap_matrix), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(heatmap_matrix) == 0) {
    message("No finite enrichment values to plot.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Define colour scale
  value_range <- range(heatmap_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (diff(value_range) == 0) {
    value_range <- value_range + c(-0.5, 0.5)
  }

  # Plot heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_matrix,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "firebrick"))(100),
    breaks = seq(value_range[1], value_range[2], length.out = 101),
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 6,
    fontsize_col = 8,
    angle_col = 90,
    main = if (pathway == "GO") {
      "GO"
    } else {
      "KEGG"
    },
    display_numbers = sig_matrix,
    number_color = "black",
    na_col = "white"
  )
}


# Generate separate heatmaps
make_pathway_heatmap("GO")
make_pathway_heatmap("KEGG")

```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Interaction_Venn, fig.height=7,fig.width=7}
  filter(str_detect(Comparisons, "^Sig_Sp_inter_")) %>%
  mutate(
    Time = str_extract(Comparisons, "Traj[0-9]+"),
    DEG = adj.P.Val < 0.05
  ) %>%
  filter(DEG)

genes_list <- list(

  Day25  = df %>% filter(Time == "Traj25")  %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day515  = df %>% filter(Time == "Traj515")  %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique(),
  Day1530 = df %>% filter(Time == "Traj1530") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique()
)

ggVennDiagram(genes_list, label = "count") +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),

  )
```

#### Proportion
```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Interaction_proportion}
TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")
ComparisonNames <- readRDS("data/DGE/ComparisonNames_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")
RNA_sets <- readRDS("data/DGE/RNAsets_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

days <- c("02", "25", "515", "1530")

prop_df <- map_dfr(days, function(day) {

  x <- RNA_sets[[paste0("Sig_Sp_inter_Traj", day)]]

  tibble(
    trajectory = day,

    INTER_DEG = length(x$DEGs$Gene),
    INTER_NonDEG = length(x$NonDEGs$Gene)
  )
})

# IMPORTANT: use TRUE universe (same logic as trajectory plot)
total_genes <- prop_df$INTER_DEG + prop_df$INTER_NonDEG

prop_df <- prop_df %>%
  mutate(
    INTER_DEG = INTER_DEG / total_genes,
    INTER_NonDEG = INTER_NonDEG / total_genes
  )

prop_long <- prop_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -trajectory,
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "prop"
  )

prop_long$trajectory <- factor(
  prop_long$trajectory,
  levels = c("02", "25", "515", "1530"),
  labels = c("0–2", "2–5", "5–15", "15–30")
)

ggplot(prop_long, aes(x = trajectory, y = prop, fill = type)) +
   geom_col(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Time window",
    y = "Proportion of genes",
    fill = ""
  )

```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Interaction_proportion2}
   Pos_human = length(x$H_pos_C_neg$Gene),
   
   Pos_chimp = length(x$H_neg_C_pos$Gene)
  )

  pivot_longer(
    cols = -trajectory,
    names_to = "type",

  mutate(
    prop = count / sum(count)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Differential_Data_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Interaction_GoPlotting5, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
all_go_results <- readRDS("data/DGE/InteractionsGo_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

sig_thresh <- 0.05

# Developmental comparisons
comparisons <- c(
  "InterTraj02",
  "InterTraj25",
  "InterTraj515",
  "InterTraj1530"
)

# Enrichment categories
categories <- c(
  "H_pos_C_neg",
  "H_neg_C_pos",
  "Both_pos",
  "Both_neg",
  "Both_pos",
  "Same_direction",
  "Opposite_direction",
  "All"
)


# ============================================================
# Function to extract one enrichment category
# ============================================================

get_go_data <- function(category) {
  
  bind_rows(
    lapply(comparisons, function(comp) {
      
      df <- all_go_results[[comp]][[category]]
      
      # Handle empty enrichment results
      if (nrow(df) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      df %>%
        filter(p.adjust < sig_thresh) %>%
        arrange(p.adjust) %>%
        slice_head(n = 5) %>%
        transmute(
          Comparison = comp,
          term_name = Description,
          p.adjust = p.adjust
        )
    })
  )
}


# ============================================================
# Function to make one heatmap
# ============================================================

make_go_heatmap <- function(category) {
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Get top significant terms for each comparison
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  top_terms <- get_go_data(category)
  
  if (nrow(top_terms) == 0) {
    message("No significant GO terms for: ", category)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # All unique terms selected across comparisons
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  unique_terms <- unique(top_terms$term_name)
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Re-extract all occurrences of those terms
  # and use the most significant p.adjust if duplicated
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  heatmap_data <- bind_rows(
    lapply(comparisons, function(comp) {
      
      df <- all_go_results[[comp]][[category]]
      
      if (nrow(df) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      df %>%
        filter(
          Description %in% unique_terms,
          p.adjust < sig_thresh
        ) %>%
        transmute(
          Comparison = comp,
          term_name = Description,
          logp = -log10(p.adjust)
        )
    })
  ) %>%
    group_by(Comparison, term_name) %>%
    summarise(
      logp = max(logp, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Wide matrix
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  heatmap_wide <- heatmap_data %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Comparison,
      values_from = logp
    )
  
  
  # Force developmental order
  heatmap_wide <- heatmap_wide %>%
    dplyr::select(
      term_name,
      any_of(comparisons)
    )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Save wide data
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  saveRDS(
    heatmap_wide,
    paste0(
      "data/Cormotif/Species/",
      category,
      "GoWide_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS"
    )
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Long format
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  heatmap_long <- heatmap_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -term_name,
      names_to = "Comparison",
      values_to = "logp"
    )
  
  
  saveRDS(
    heatmap_long,
    paste0(
      "data/Cormotif/Species/",
      category,
      "GoLong_logcpm_G1_SpTp_No4_NoRep.RDS"
    )
  )
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Prepare matrix
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_wide %>%
    column_to_rownames("term_name") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  
  heatmap_matrix[is.na(heatmap_matrix)] <- 0
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Significance matrix
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  sig_matrix <- heatmap_long %>%
    mutate(
      sig = ifelse(!is.na(logp) & logp > -log10(sig_thresh), "*", "")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Comparison,
      term_name,
      sig
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Comparison,
      values_from = sig,
      values_fill = ""
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      term_name,
      any_of(comparisons)
    ) %>%
    column_to_rownames("term_name") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  
  pheatmap(
    heatmap_matrix,
    color = colorRampPalette(
      c("grey90", "firebrick")
    )(100),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 6,
    fontsize_col = 8,
    main = paste("GO:BP Enrichment -", category),
    display_numbers = sig_matrix,
    number_color = "black"
  )
}


# ============================================================
# Generate all three heatmaps
# ============================================================

make_go_heatmap("All")


```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Interaction_EnrichGo_AllInteractions2,fig.height=10,fig.height=10}
      comp_list,

          filter(
            Description %in% GO_terms_to_plot$Description[
```

```{r RNASeq_DGE_Interaction_EnrichGo_AllInteractions_plotting3, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(tibble)

GO_plot_data <- readRDS(
  "data/DGE/InteractionGoPlot_PlusAllInteraction_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_NoRep_No4.RDS"
)

# Prepare values and significance labels
heatmap_data <- GO_plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    Column = paste(Comparison, GeneSet, sep = "_"),
    logp = -log10(pmax(p.adjust, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    sig = ifelse(p.adjust < 0.05, "*", "")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Description, Column) %>%
  summarise(
    logp = max(logp, na.rm = TRUE),
    sig = ifelse(any(sig == "*"), "*", ""),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Numeric matrix
heatmap_wide <- heatmap_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Description, Column, logp) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Column, values_from = logp)

heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Description") %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(heatmap_matrix) <- "numeric"

# Significance matrix, matching the numeric matrix
sig_wide <- heatmap_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Description, Column, sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Column, values_from = sig, values_fill = "")

sig_matrix <- sig_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Description") %>%
  as.matrix()

sig_matrix <- sig_matrix[
  rownames(heatmap_matrix),
  colnames(heatmap_matrix),
  drop = FALSE
]

# Plot in the style of your example
value_range <- range(heatmap_matrix[is.finite(heatmap_matrix)])

gene_set_order <- c(
  "All",
  "Both_pos",
  "Both_neg",
  "H_pos_C_neg",
  "H_neg_C_pos",
  "Same_direction",
  "Opposite_direction"
)

comparison_order <- c(
  "InterTraj02",
  "InterTraj25",
  "InterTraj515",
  "InterTraj1530",
  "InteractionAtLeastOne"
)

column_order <- unlist(lapply(comparison_order, function(comp) {
  paste(comp, gene_set_order, sep = "_")
}))

column_order <- column_order[column_order %in% colnames(heatmap_matrix)]

heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[, column_order, drop = FALSE]
sig_matrix <- sig_matrix[, column_order, drop = FALSE]

pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("grey90", "firebrick"))(100),
  breaks = seq(value_range[1], value_range[2], length.out = 101),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  fontsize_col = 7,
  angle_col = 90,
  main = "GO:BP Enrichment Across Interaction Gene Sets",
  display_numbers = sig_matrix,
  number_color = "black",
  na_col = "white"
)
```
